raw_response:
The company exhibits significant financial weaknesses, including a current ratio of 0.90 indicating immediate liquidity concerns, negative working capital, and very high leverage (debt-to-equity ratio of ~4.17 and debt-to-total assets of 80.5%). While the EBIT margin of 16.5% and large retained earnings suggest operational profitability and some financial resilience, these are outweighed by the high leverage and poor liquidity, leading to elevated default risk, characteristic of speculative-grade ratings. The liquidity shortfall and high financial risk place the rating in the B range based on standard credit metrics.

DECISION: B
